numbered_requirements.method: Fallback comparison, not a full bisect. Unit rules prohibit branch/checkout changes; the current harness preloads APIs and Warband fixtures absent on October 8. Reproducible adapter preserves ordinary seed 83, 1920x1080, 100% scale, 1.5s settle, 4s idle, 6s sweep, uncapped CPU sampling, and profiling sink. No Git mutations in disposable checkout.
numbered_requirements.caveat: October ordinary uses its own generator revision. Its sweep does not exercise enemy stage submission, so zero phase entries below mean not exercised, not zero intrinsic cost. Commit/path attribution is inspection-backed, not a bisection-proven single culprit.

implementation: One visible roster per synchronous submission; expired immediately and uncached direct queries still reflect mutation.
HUD source registrations restricted to HUD-bearing units; existing exact 32-entry layout LRU warmed at room/layout/obstacle changes and focus restored before drawing.
Hover HUD updates coalesced in the same deferred pre-draw flush, with no timer or animation-cadence change.
Contour solver prunes losing offsets while preserving exact score arithmetic and strict tie order.
Retained source bindings read once per field; no extra persistent binding cache.
Badge actor bounds resolved once per draw and cached health rectangles avoid eager fallback. Raw live catalog identity avoids scaled definition copies.
Overlay selectors evaluated once per synchronous draw; original ordered tile commands and global wind ordering retained.
Stationary base paths compose Tether routes before the preparation size check.
Torch coefficients use exact Float64 samples, bounded to the current room. Motion, alpha, geometry, texture choice, ordering and cadence remain live.
Rest-badge focus uses identity only, with the original first-match/alive/privacy/footprint/fallback policy. run_scene.gd remains one line added and one removed.

phase_table.definition: Maximum inclusive phase cost within the run selected by minimum of three whole-frame maxima; phases are not additive and maxima need not share a frame.

rows.responsible_path_or_change: HUD solves keyed by all cutout registrations, including destination ghosts excluded from HUD rendering; per-hover solve precedes deferred stage update. New ghost paths: wbv-01 (2a5eedc77); directional art metadata copies: art-03 (6b4927d2f).
Legacy continuously animated torch work; similar October cost, not the main regression. Candidate caches only exact seed coefficients and preserves live motion/alpha/texture selection.
Every presentation/HUD field fetched and assigned per retained layer. At-rest presentation fields were added in ITB-01/03 (d998663ac, b18951e46); October sweep did not exercise a stage submission.
ITB-03 intent badges (b18951e46): repeated actor bounds per badge and eager health-rectangle fallback despite a cache hit.

At-rest badge isolation plus a second full enemy threat lookup solely to obtain enemy_key (ITB-01, d998663ac). Identity lookup now preserves the exact visibility/footprint/first-match policy without a second threat query.

ITB-01/03 threat tiles and zone tags, Warband command glow (49b3f160f), Burrow/Burst selectors, and perf-03 per-tile diagnostic timing. Per-draw selectors now shared. Residual selected-pass phase peak is higher; not all expensive overlays have been eliminated.

Visible roster rebuilt for both pre/post cutout floor-registration samples while submission cache was invalid, then again for retained data. New rig families increase this work; candidate prepares exactly one roster per synchronous submission.
Original immediate hover HUD solve moved to the same-frame deferred flush after RunScene presentation; unchanged layouts retain their commands.

measurements.selection_rule: minimum of three maxima; all statistics from that selected pass
